0022600176.text: The Nets (1-5, 15th in the East) are 0-3 at home, though they come in on a one-game winning streak, and they are without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Hornets (3-4, 8th in the East) have lost three straight, and Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel are both out with hamstring injuries. In the series, Brooklyn trails 0-1 in 2026-27 after a 110-103 loss at home on October 21, and the Nets lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series.
